limitations: PRNG samples treated as iid under registered generator law
eight fixed histories, not independent task samples
finite support is not an empirical posterior for other views
bounded Monte Carlo intervals can be wide
the fit-selected lookup is a diagnostic finite-history reference, not a new general neural policy
step cost is a utility proxy; measured compute/time are reported separately, without converting wall time to utility
